scope: Exploratory quarterly diagnostic of same 2022-2024 controlled offshore annual candidate, not monthly metered validation
frozen_2022_annual_scales: Reuse all three Stage18 annual scale factors without quarterly/year refit
observations: Use company-authored Q1/H1/9M reports for2023 and2024, including2022 comparisons; Q4 from annual minus9M
revision_handling: Retain duplicate2023 disclosures, compare at displayed precision; disagreements flag rather than silently average
rounding: Each reported cumulative MWh halfwidth500; quarter differences halfwidth1000; shared endpoints imply dependent quarter errors
metrics: Unscaled and scaled gross MWh and error per quarter for all three curves
Annual sum identity and absolute-quarter-error versus net annual-error cancellation
Gross and export reported separately; no conversion using CO2 or availability
exclusions: No new wind model or clipped replacement
No tuning or selecting best curve
No p-values or independence claim from12 quarters
No reinterpretation of company scope as direct plant metering
known_data: All annual model profiles and observed annual totals known; several cumulative observations already read. Plan frozen before quarterly model aggregation, not preregistration or blind holdout.
